branch_head_sha_note: Branch search did not expose a head SHA. File blob SHAs are not commit SHAs.
last_verified_source_commit_scope: Revision returned by GitHub code search for inspected GIS files; not asserted as the feature branch HEAD.
verified_findings: IRNI is the canonical geography owner; Radar Worker reads through the internal IRNI_GEOGRAPHY Service Binding.
Radar Worker IRNI v2 client and neighborhood identity resolver validate registry metadata, revision, checksum and exact namespaced legacy aliases.
The Express Geospatial module has a boundary evidence read model and review/approval scaffold with geometry hash and explicit EPSG:4326 CRS.

apps/api/server.ts constructs createProductionGeospatialModule() without canonical identity, trusted source-registry or approval authorization dependencies; read model must remain BLOCKED and approval fail-closed.
Worker-generated computed_hex_fallback geometry is approximate and visualization-only.
The geography geometry engine implements WGS84 validation, ring closure, self-intersection checks, hole containment, point-in-polygon and selected CRS transformations.
Geospatial service persistence is AtomicJsonRepository('geospatial-state.json') with optional remote repository-snapshot persistence, not a relational D1 schema.
wrangler.backend.jsonc declares USER_DB, DB, RESEARCH_DB and IRNI_GEOGRAPHY; no Radar-owned GIS D1 binding is declared.
The NIPS V2 reference design is the authoritative neighborhood-profile specification; do not duplicate it.
Profile evidence builder now explicitly rejects sourceProvenance=computed_hex_fallback even if an injected source resolver returns publishable authority; regression test added but not executed.

database_decision.current_geospatial_persistence: Atomic JSON repository with optional remote repository snapshot
database_decision.rule: Do not create RTree virtual tables or claim D1-native spatial predicates until a disposable/staging D1 Worker runtime probe succeeds.
database_decision.evidence: D1 SQL documentation lists FTS5, JSON and math functions in its supported extension subset. The 2026-11-12 virtual-table export changelog is export support, not proof of runtime SQL support.

completed_work_packages.summary: Inspected AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, RMEP persistent memory and execution state; located existing GIS and NIPS V2 implementation; identified canonical ownership and production wiring blockers.
Checked current Cloudflare D1 SQL extension documentation and export changelog; RTree runtime capability remains unverified.
Confirmed Geospatial boundary/POI/overlay/import state is persisted through geospatial-state.json AtomicJsonRepository and optional remote snapshots, not a D1 relational schema.
Added defense-in-depth rejection of computed_hex_fallback in the neighborhood profile evidence builder and a regression test that simulates an over-permissive source resolver.

blockers.description: No authenticated, version-pinned IRNI Worker-to-Express identity resolver bridge is wired.
Trusted source-registry resolver is not implemented or injected.
Boundary approval HTTP route lacks injected admin token verification and authorization store.
Current IRNI neighborhood entities are point-only; no verified neighborhood polygons or measured areas are available.
D1 RTree virtual-table runtime support has not been demonstrated against an actual D1 Worker binding.
Geometry validation needs explicit tests for hole-ring intersections, overlapping MultiPolygon components and cross-neighborhood topology.
Radar geospatial state is not stored in a relational D1 schema; storage owner and migration boundary for Radar-owned GIS records are unresolved.

tests.note: Repository source inspection and current public D1 documentation review only; no local test runner or live D1 runtime was executed.

next_exact_action: Run tests/neighborhood-profile-boundary-read-model.test.ts and the relevant geospatial typecheck in a real checkout; then add an equivalent guard to property-to-neighborhood assignment if any route can persist computed_hex_fallback as a boundary record.
